card.name: Time units after once, per, or a dose
card.fires_on: Time-period words such as daily, day, month and January, mostly right after a dose amount or 'once' in dosing instructions. Also fires on calendar or periodic-event wording in general text.

modes.description: A month or period word in general text about dates or recurring events.
